approvedNonPhysicsDifferences.explanation: REPLACE_WITH_EXACT_REVIEWED_PREVIEW_ONLY_DIFF_AND_WHY_NO_MODE0_DRAG_WATER_SPRING_OR_VICTORY_BEHAVIOR_CHANGED. Added files use baseSha256:null; removed files use otherSha256:null. Every differing path/hash pair needs its own explicit entry. postImportInteraction.note: The independent actual Unity Input61 run must start after the last supplied retest and pass all61+ checks, including native pressure/same-cell Undo and camera/prefs restoration. Its runtime snapshot is independently compared against the same base and exact approved differences; merely declaring passed is insufficient.

twoHalfMode: Pass --base HALF1.json --base HALF2.json. Both finished planned400 reports must contain the identical expectedCatalog800ids/11919 records; their actual level sets must be disjoint and union exactly that catalog. Add one runtime binding per actual report SHA. All source comparisons, including the secondhalf and final Input61, use the firstbase as the from/baseSHA anchor.
